I can see the issue. The `page_count` function uses integer division (`//`) which doesn't account for the remainder. When you have 21 items with 10 per page, you need 3 pages (2 full pages + 1 partial page), but `21 // 10 = 2`.

The fix is to use ceiling division: `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page` or use `math.ceil`.
